decisions.reason: Reporting isolation does not change the payout requirement, and the same message already records the separate Wix account and payment setup mechanism.
The candidate already establishes separate Wix websites and accounts from this message; adding reporting isolation does not further change the site architecture.
Location-specific reporting isolation does not necessarily change the existing requirement to support integration of future locations.
Reporting isolation does not change the Wix booking platform, and this message's location-context expansion is already represented.
The candidate already records the message's master-site selection and routing behavior; reporting isolation does not alter that routing.
Independent reporting by location does not change the Smash Room brand name or its application.
The operational reporting decision does not change the visual-design reference, layout style, or navigation style.
Location-level reporting isolation remains compatible with and does not modify the master site's existing brand-and-information aggregation role.
